findings.title: Findings converge on msgspec conversion as D2's parsing mechanism
findings.why_it_matters: Three findings land on D2's msgspec conversion; replacing it would remove each local fix.
findings.recommended: B: Keep msgspec conversion and address Findings 2, 6, and 12 individually.
findings.chosen: B: Keep msgspec conversion and address Findings 2, 6, and 12 individually

findings.title: HSL101 breaks the generic parse, and the ledger doesn't say who owns the merge
findings.why_it_matters: Nothing owns HSL101's merge-and-cap wrapper, and tokens has two meanings.
findings.recommended: A: Keep tokens as user input, expose the resolved set as a families property read by spec_tokens, and declare the combined cap on the field.
findings.chosen: B: Add a parse/resolve hook to the Rule row, and keep tokens holding the merged list.
findings.choice_reason: The user asked whether the hook should be built now rather than later. A simulation then showed the families property fails 4 of 106 tests that isolate a family, and the agent changed its recommendation to B.

findings.title: The table's row shape isn't pinned for HSL900, option-less rules, or #59
findings.why_it_matters: Optional fields on one Rule would make every consumer branch.
findings.recommended: A: Metadata row for every rule; FileRule adds detect and options; #59 adds a sibling ProjectRule
findings.chosen: A: Metadata row for every rule; FileRule adds detect and options; #59 adds a sibling ProjectRule

findings.title: The ledger gives no home to HSL101's vocabularies and limits
findings.why_it_matters: Leaving SEPARATOR_REGEX and SUFFIX_REGEX in config brings the import cycle back.
findings.chosen: Named the home for the vocabularies and limits under New homes.

findings.title: Moving detect_candidates carries over a redundant loop and a silent skip
findings.why_it_matters: The move would keep a second loop and a silent skip.
findings.chosen: One dispatch loop in scanner.py; detect_candidates and registry.py are deleted.

findings.title: The Build section omits msgspec details the old code handles implicitly
findings.why_it_matters: A Struct without forbid_unknown_fields silently accepts a typo'd key.
findings.chosen: Listed the msgspec requirements in the Summary's Must hold in the build, because the template reserves the Build section for build mode.

findings.title: rules.HSL001 staying an unknown key has no test
findings.why_it_matters: Only one literal set enforces it today.
findings.chosen: Listed a pin test in the Summary's Must hold in the build, because the template reserves the Build section for build mode.

findings.title: D4 makes the cache module's docstring false
findings.why_it_matters: The docstring would claim identical files always share an entry.
findings.chosen: Added the cache.py docstrings to the In scope list.

findings.title: The ledger doesn't state which decisions depend on msgspec
findings.why_it_matters: Judging D2's reversibility needs that boundary.

findings.title: Hashing every rule's options will include project-rule options
findings.why_it_matters: HSL104 option edits would invalidate per-file entries they can't affect.
findings.recommended: A: Keep D3 as ratified, and leave any filter to #59.
findings.chosen: A: Keep D3 as ratified, and leave any filter to #59.

findings.title: The cache infers language from the filename instead of being told
findings.why_it_matters: A configured language mapping could replay a stale result.
findings.recommended: B: Accept as a known limitation
findings.chosen: B: Accept as a known limitation

findings.title: D2's dependency risk is accepted on weak grounds
findings.why_it_matters: Getting out of msgspec means writing the parsers it replaced.
findings.recommended: B: Accept as a known limitation
findings.chosen: B: Accept as a known limitation
